title: 26 U.S.C. 985 — Functional currency
quotation: (b)(1) 'the term "functional currency" means— (A) except as provided in subparagraph (B), the dollar, or (B) in the case of a qualified business unit, the currency of the economic environment in which a significant part of such unit's activities are conducted'.

title: 26 U.S.C. 1001 — Determination of amount of and recognition of gain or loss
quotation: (a) 'The gain from the sale or other disposition of property shall be the excess of the amount realized therefrom over the adjusted basis'. title: 26 U.S.C. 1012 — Basis of property—cost
quotation: (a) 'The basis of property shall be the cost of such property, except as otherwise provided in this subchapter'.

title: 26 U.S.C. 1014 — Basis of property acquired from a decedent
quotation: (a) 'the basis of property in the hands of a person acquiring the property from a decedent … shall … be— (1) the fair market value of the property at the date of the decedent's death'.

title: 26 U.S.C. 1015 — Basis of property acquired by gifts and transfers in trust
quotation: (a) 'the basis shall be the same as it would be in the hands of the donor … except that if such basis … is greater than the fair market value of the property at the time of the gift, then for the purpose of determining loss the basis shall be such fair market value.'
